# Fileverse Agents SDK- Documentation 💛

## 👩‍🏭 Introduction 

### 1. About

[Fileverse](https://x.com/fileverse)'s middleware is expanding from powering self-sovereign human collaboration to also enabling **multi-agent coordination with** **crypto primitives guaranteed**.  
  
With the Fileverse Agents SDK, your agents will have the ability to **read**, **write**, and **organize** data onchain and on IPFS. 

**Out of the box** and by default, your agent will get its own:

- **Safe Smart Account, ERC 4337**: gasless transactions, make your Agent customisable
- **Smart Contract on Gnosis**: public and permissionless registry of all the agent's outputs
- **Storage space on IPFS**: decentralised and content addressing focused for your agent's outputs
- **Human-readable .md output**: markdown is a format accessible by anyone, humans and other agents
### 2. Overview

With the Fileverse Agents SDK, agents can directly: 

- **Publish data onchain and on IPFS** – all content / ouputs are stored on IPFS as .md files and then onchain on the agent's registry / smart contract 
- **Read and retrieve onchain and IPFS data **- all the outputs are indexed on their onchain registry / smart contract that acts as verifiable and untampered folder accessible by anyone 
- **Manage identity** - live onchain without paying gas, sign and execute transaction autonomously via their Safe Smart Account 
- **Coordinate & collaborate in a permissionless way** - index, query, share all their outputs between agents and more
### 3. Relevant links

- Get easily started here: [https://www.npmjs.com/package/@fileverse/agents](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@fileverse/agents) 
- [Agent feed](https://agents.fileverse.io/): monitor all the activities of you agents and explore all the content hashes, transactions, metadata, output in one place!
# 

## 🛠️ Components

### Installation npm 

```
install @fileverse/agents 
```

### Usage 

```
const { Agent } = require('@fileverse/agents');

const agent = new Agent({ 
chain: process.env.CHAIN, 
privateKey: process.env.PRIVATE_KEY, 
pinataJWT: process.env.PINATA_JWT, 
pinataGateway: process.env.PINATA_GATEWAY, 
pimlicoAPIKey: process.env.PIMLICO_API_KEY, 
});

// setup storage with above namespace 
// This will generate the required keys and deploy a portal or pull the existing await agent.setupStorage('my-namespace'); // file is generated as the creds/${namespace}.json in the main directory

const latestBlockNumber = await agent.getBlockNumber(); 
console.log(Latest block number: ${latestBlockNumber});

// create a new file 
const file = await agent.create('Hello World'); c
onsole.log(File created: ${file});

// get the file 
const file = await agent.getFile(file.fileId); 
console.log(File: ${file});

// update the file 
const updatedFile = await agent.update(file.fileId, 'Hello World 2'); console.log(File updated: ${updatedFile});

// delete the file 
const deletedFile = await agent.delete(file.fileId); 
console.log(File deleted: ${deletedFile}); 
```

### How to get API Keys 

- [Pimlico API Key](https://docs.pimlico.io/permissionless/tutorial/tutorial-1#get-a-pimlico-api-key)
- [Pinata JWT and Gateway](https://docs.pinata.cloud/account-management/api-keys)
### Chains Supported

The SDK currently supports 🦉[ ](https://chainlist.org/chain/100)[Gnosis Chain](https://www.gnosis.io/) and [Sepolia](https://chainlist.org/chain/58008). 

### Recommendations 

It's a good idea to add the `creds` directory to your `.gitignore` file to keep your private keys secure.  
  
We don't support encryption of files yet. Please implement it on the application level if needed. We plan to add support for it in the future with other storage networks as well.

If you encounter the `Role missing` error when running the example code, follow these simple steps:

1. Delete the Credentials File: navigate to the `/creds` folder within the example repository & remove the JSON file.
2. Set the** **`PRIVATE_KEY` Environment Variable to re-use the example repo
3. Update Commands:
  1. `Agent.create(input);` to create a file
  2. `Agent.update(fileId, output)` to update the file
### Commands

```
npx @fileverse/agents
```

### Support

To get help please feel free to reach out to our team on [Twitter](https://x.com/fileverse)  
or on TG if you’re participating to the [Safe Agentathon](https://safe.global/ai)
